headline: Jaishankar to lead Indian delegation at UN General Assembly
paragraphs: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar will lead India’s delegation during the High-Level Week of the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York and will address the high-level session on September 26.

The annual General Debate of the UNGA is being held from September 22 to 28 under the theme, “Restoring trust, managing transformation: A United Nations that delivers for all.” The session brings together heads of state, government leaders and representatives from member countries to discuss global challenges and priorities.

According to the Ministry of External Affairs, Jaishankar will participate in a series of plurilateral and bilateral meetings on the sidelines of the UNGA. His engagements are expected to focus on key global issues, including international security, sustainable development, climate action and cooperation among nations.

Jaishankar’s visit comes at a time when India has been advocating reforms in multilateral institutions, including a greater role for developing countries in global decision-making bodies. India has repeatedly called for the expansion of the United Nations Security Council to make it more representative of contemporary geopolitical realities.
The External Affairs Minister is also expected to highlight India’s perspectives on issues affecting the Global South during his interactions with international counterparts.

The UNGA High-Level Week provides a platform for countries to present their national priorities and engage in discussions on economic, political and humanitarian concerns. Jaishankar’s address will outline India’s approach towards global cooperation and its role in international affairs.
